name: The Defias Brotherhood

narrative.details:
What I am about to tell you could cost me my life.  The Defias gang is up to something big.  Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.

Take this note to Stoutmantle.  It explains as much as I know on the subject.
narrative.objectives: Take Wiley's Note to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: Bah! I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance. But this information is crucial. Good work.
narrative.requestItemsText: Good to see you back, adventurer. What did Wiley have to say for himself?
